records.title: Bounded-pass Bellman-Ford
records.summary: Relax every edge for at most V-1 passes, optionally stop when unchanged, then test for a source-reachable negative cycle.

records.title: FIFO layered graph traversal
records.summary: Use VecDeque and discover-on-enqueue to compute reachability, minimum edge counts, and parent paths from a source.

records.title: Bounded priority frontier
records.summary: Maintain only the best k candidates using a heap whose root is the current eviction boundary.

records.title: BST ordered descent and pruning
records.summary: Follow only the child subtree whose inherited key interval can contain the target or ordered neighbor.

records.title: Constraint-guided backtracking
records.summary: Enumerate choices depth-first, reject impossible partial states, emit complete solutions, and restore mutable state.

records.title: Converging two pointers
records.summary: Move one of two monotone endpoints according to sorted/dominance information until all relevant pairs or merge choices are resolved.

records.title: DFS cycle-certified topological traversal
records.summary: Explore directed dependencies depth-first with active/finished state, returning either a cycle witness or reverse finish order.

records.title: Lazy-heap Dijkstra
records.summary: Relax nonnegative weighted edges from the current minimum distance and skip obsolete heap records.

records.title: Earliest-finish compatible interval selection
records.summary: Sort by finish time and repeatedly take the next interval compatible with the last selected one to maximize unweighted count.

records.title: Exact binary lookup
records.summary: Use ordered random access to find any exact match or its insertion point while preserving a shrinking candidate interval.

records.title: FIFO frontier
records.summary: Enqueue discovered work at the back and process the earliest waiting item from the front.

records.title: Fractional value-density fill
records.summary: Sort divisible supplies by value per capacity unit and exhaust higher density before lower density until capacity is filled.

records.title: Frequency map
records.summary: Associate each canonical key with its occurrence count or other accumulated per-key state.

records.title: Incremental contiguous window
records.summary: Enumerate fixed windows or expand/shrink a feasible interval while adding and removing endpoint contributions exactly once.

records.title: LIFO frontier
records.summary: Push unresolved nested/deferred state and resolve the most recent item first.

records.title: Membership set
records.summary: Track whether a key has appeared when no associated count/value is required.

records.title: Monotone boundary search
records.summary: Find the transition between a true prefix and false suffix, such as a lower or upper duplicate bound.

records.title: Prefix range aggregate
records.summary: Precompute cumulative states once so many static half-open range sums use two boundary values.

records.title: Explicit-unit prefix trie
records.summary: Traverse one declared key unit per edge for exact membership and prefix enumeration under measured memory constraints.

records.title: One-dimensional sequence DP
records.summary: Order positions and choose the best predecessor transition into each suffix/prefix state, with explicit unreachable/base state.

records.title: Single-pass prefix-state invariant
records.summary: Scan once while retaining only the state needed to summarize the processed prefix and update the best/current answer.

records.title: Sorted interval coalescing sweep
records.summary: Sort validated intervals by start and merge overlap or policy-defined adjacency in one pass.

records.title: Structural recursive decomposition
records.summary: Solve a base structure directly and combine results from strictly smaller children or suffixes.

records.title: Semantics-first tree traversal
records.summary: Visit every node in preorder, inorder, postorder, or level order according to when the node result becomes valid.

records.title: Two-sequence prefix/suffix DP
records.summary: Use one index per sequence and transitions for aligned/substituted/deleted/inserted next units under an explicit string-unit/cost contract.

records.title: Incremental equivalence connectivity
records.summary: Map stable item IDs to parent/size arrays and answer connectivity while processing irreversible unions.

records.title: 0/1 item-capacity DP
records.summary: Index by item boundary and remaining/used integral capacity; choose skip or take once when it fits.

records.title: Accumulator width and overflow policy
records.summary: Bound prefix/window totals independently of elements and use checked arithmetic or a justified wider representation.

records.title: Adjacency-list size and traversal cost
records.summary: Count V plus stored adjacency entries E under the declared direction/duplicate policy, including isolated vertices.

records.title: Abstract behavior versus representation
records.summary: Specify access/removal order first, then choose a concrete Rust container from required operations and costs.

records.title: Amortized cost
records.summary: Bound total cost across an operation sequence so occasional expensive operations have a justified average per operation.

records.title: Analysis and measurement
records.summary: Use asymptotic reasoning for scalable bounds and controlled measurements for constants, allocation, cache, and actual distributions.

records.title: Asymptotic growth bound
records.summary: Describe resource growth for large inputs while separating upper, lower, and tight claims.

records.title: Auxiliary space
records.summary: Count additional memory used by the algorithm separately from input and required output storage.

records.title: Sound partial-state pruning
records.summary: Reject a partial state only when every possible completion violates a stated constraint.

records.title: Choose-explore-undo restoration
records.summary: Each mutable choice has a paired undo so every sibling begins from the same parent state, including early exits.

records.title: Bellman-Ford pass and cycle invariant
records.summary: After i full edge passes, shortest paths using at most i edges are represented; a further improvement after V-1 passes proves a reachable negative cycle.

records.title: BFS layer and parent invariant
records.summary: The queue processes nondecreasing unweighted distance and every discovered non-source parent proves a path one edge shorter.

records.title: Half-open binary-search invariant
records.summary: Maintain a shrinking [lo, hi) interval that contains every index still capable of satisfying the target predicate.

records.title: Global BST ordering invariant
records.summary: Every key in a left/right subtree obeys inherited bounds, with duplicates handled by one declared policy.

records.title: Worst, best, average, and expected cases
records.summary: Tie a resource claim to maximum/minimum inputs, an explicit input distribution, or algorithmic randomness.

records.title: Operation cost model
records.summary: Name which primitive operations are counted and which representation/library assumptions make them constant, logarithmic, or linear.

records.title: DFS undiscovered-active-finished state
records.summary: Track whether a vertex is unseen, on the current recursion/explicit stack, or completely explored.

records.title: Dijkstra settled-distance invariant
records.summary: With nonnegative edges, the minimum unsettled finite estimate removed from the priority queue equals its final shortest distance.

records.title: Directed cycle witness
records.summary: An edge to an active ancestor plus parent/stack state reconstructs a concrete directed cycle.

records.title: DP state-transition cost model
records.summary: Total time is reachable state count times transition work per state plus setup/reconstruction; space counts live table/witness state.

records.title: DP dependency DAG and evaluation order
records.summary: Every transition points to a strictly smaller/earlier state; memoization follows demand while tabulation follows a topological order.

records.title: Memoization versus tabulation
records.summary: Top-down memoization evaluates reachable states once; bottom-up tabulation evaluates a declared order and can expose compression opportunities.

records.title: Pseudo-polynomial numeric state
records.summary: A table dimension proportional to numeric capacity C is polynomial in C but may be exponential in the bit length used to encode C.

records.title: Deterministic DP witness reconstruction
records.summary: Store or recompute an optimal predecessor/choice under a total tie policy, then validate the produced witness against the table value.

records.title: Base cases and exhaustive recurrence
records.summary: Define terminal states and minimize/maximize over every legal first/last decision, with checked unreachable sentinels.

records.title: Dependency-safe space compression
records.summary: Retain only state layers still needed by future transitions, respecting in-place update direction and witness requirements.

records.title: Sufficient DP state
records.summary: A state stores exactly the context needed to determine legal future choices and the optimal continuation value.

records.title: Union by size/rank plus path compression
records.summary: Attach the shallower/smaller root and compress find paths, analyzing the whole operation sequence amortized.

records.title: Parent-forest representative invariant
records.summary: Each item follows parent links to one root representative; roots parent themselves and sets are exactly equal-root classes.

records.title: Disjoint-set partition contract
records.summary: Maintain a partition of known items under make, representative lookup, and irreversible set merge.

records.title: Safe edge relaxation
records.summary: If u is reachable and d[u]+w(u,v) is checked and smaller, update d[v] and parent[v] to a real path witness.

records.title: Exact-match and insertion-point result
records.summary: An exact search returns one matching index or a valid insertion position, not a promised first duplicate.

records.title: Exchange and cut-and-paste proof
records.summary: Transform an arbitrary optimum to include the greedy choice without reducing objective or violating feasibility, then recurse on the remainder.

records.title: FIFO order
records.summary: The next removal returns the earliest enqueued live item.

records.title: Fixed-size overlapping window
records.summary: Visit every contiguous region of one positive length and update or recompute its value under an explicit short-input contract.

records.title: Fractional versus indivisible choice boundary
records.summary: Divisibility permits proportional exchange by density; indivisible choices can strand capacity and invalidate that proof.

records.title: Frontier invariant
records.summary: The container holds exactly discovered or pending work not yet completed, ordered by the selected policy.

records.title: Graph direction and identity contract
records.summary: Declare vertex identity, directedness, self/parallel-edge behavior, missing references, and observable ordering.

records.title: Traversal determinism policy
records.summary: Specify start and neighbor order only when result order is observable; otherwise validate semantic properties across any valid order.

records.title: Discover-on-frontier insertion
records.summary: Mark a vertex and assign its parent/distance the first time it enters the frontier, not after duplicate work.

records.title: Greedy choice property
records.summary: There exists an optimal solution compatible with the locally selected feasible choice at every step.

records.title: Minimal greedy counterexample
records.summary: Exhaust small valid instances to falsify an unproved local rule and shrink the first failure to its essential constraints.

records.title: Validated half-open interval
records.summary: Represent [start,end) with start <= end and specify empty, overlap, containment, adjacency, and coalescing behavior.

records.title: Hash cost and arbitrary order
records.summary: Treat lookup as expected, include hashing/key/capacity costs, and never infer insertion or sorted order from standard hash iteration.

records.title: Hash and equality invariant
records.summary: Equal keys must hash equally and key equality/hash-relevant state must remain stable while stored.

records.title: Binary-heap partial order
records.summary: Every parent is at least as extreme as its children, placing one extreme at the root without sorting siblings or iteration.

records.title: Heap operation and build costs
records.summary: Distinguish peek, pop, push assumptions, capacity growth, repeated extraction, and linear bulk heap construction.

records.title: In-place transformation and ownership
records.summary: Separate mutation of permitted input storage from clones, collected iterators, auxiliary state, and required output.

records.title: Algorithm input size
records.summary: Define the variable or variables that measure the growing input before stating a bound.

records.title: Interval problem boundary
records.summary: Distinguish union/coalescing, maximum unweighted compatible subset, weighted scheduling, and resource-counting objectives.

records.title: Sorted interval sweep invariant
records.summary: After processing a start-sorted prefix, output intervals are canonical/disjoint and current holds exactly the unfinished final union component.

records.title: Initialization, maintenance, termination proof
records.summary: Prove the invariant initially, prove one iteration preserves it, and combine it with termination to derive correctness.

records.title: LIFO order
records.summary: The next removal returns the most recently pushed live item.

records.title: Sequential list access and full operation cost
records.summary: Count traversal, allocation, links, cache locality, and position discovery rather than quoting pointer rewiring alone.

records.title: Loop invariant
records.summary: State a property true before and after every iteration that connects processed state to the final specification.

records.title: Sorted multi-input merge invariant
records.summary: Maintain one frontier per sorted input and emit the least eligible next key while preserving global order and multiplicity/version policy.

records.title: Monotone predicate partition
records.summary: All true elements precede all false elements, making their transition index searchable as a boundary.

records.title: Optimization feasibility and objective contract
records.summary: Define candidate set, feasibility, maximize/minimize objective, tie/output semantics, and infeasible/empty behavior before selecting a rule.

records.title: Total ordering contract
records.summary: Define a comparator or key whose equality and ordering are consistent for every value the algorithm may compare.

records.title: Owned recursive link
records.summary: Represent a single-owner acyclic next link as Option<Box<Node<T>>> with moves governing insertion/removal and automatic drop governing reclamation.

records.title: Monotone endpoint progress
records.summary: Give each pointer a precise boundary meaning and prove each update discards only states that cannot improve or satisfy the answer.

records.title: Prefix aggregate algebra
records.summary: Constant-time range recovery needs an associative prefix operation and a valid way to remove the earlier prefix.

records.title: Half-open prefix-sum identity
records.summary: Store prefix[0] = 0 and prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + value[i], so sum(l..r) = prefix[r] - prefix[l].

records.title: Priority-queue access contract
records.summary: Insert candidates and repeatedly inspect/remove the item with the most extreme declared priority.

records.title: Recursion depth and branching cost
records.summary: Analyze call-tree work, maximum live depth, per-frame state, output size, and overflow risk separately.

records.title: Recursive progress contract
records.summary: Define base cases, a strictly decreasing measure, recursive subproblems, and return/combination semantics.

records.title: Recursive frame ownership
records.summary: Separate per-call parameters/locals from shared input, output, and mutable search state.

records.title: Rooted tree and subtree
records.summary: Model one root, parent-child edges, leaves, depth, height, and recursively complete subtrees with an explicit empty case.

records.title: Rust BTreeMap ordered-map contract
records.summary: Prefer the standard ordered map for total-order keys, ordered iteration, and ranges while keeping key order stable in storage.

records.title: Rust collection operation cost
records.summary: Read the exact standard-library operation, capacity, ownership, expected, and amortized semantics before importing a textbook bound.

records.title: Minimal Rust sequence-container choice
records.summary: Default to Vec, choose VecDeque for frequent front operations, and choose linked storage only from an evidenced contract.

records.title: Rust BinaryHeap ordering contract
records.summary: Use max order by default, Reverse for min order, stable Ord-relevant state, and explicit deterministic ties.

records.title: Rust lazy priority updates
records.summary: Use Reverse over a deterministic distance/vertex key, push improvements, and discard popped entries stale against the distance table.

records.title: Rust owned binary tree
records.summary: Use Option<Box<Node<T>>> child links for a single-owner educational tree and borrow nodes during read-only traversal.

records.title: Finite Rust recursive type
records.summary: Break recursive size with pointer indirection and select Box for single ownership unless sharing is required.

records.title: Rust slice sort contract
records.summary: Choose sort or sort_unstable from stability, allocation, mutation, comparator, and key-extraction requirements rather than habit.

records.title: Rust string unit
records.summary: Choose bytes, Unicode scalar values, or user-perceived graphemes from the problem contract before indexing or counting.

records.title: Rust Vec stack
records.summary: Use push, pop, and last at the end of Vec for amortized constant LIFO operations.

records.title: Rust VecDeque queue/deque
records.summary: Use push_back/pop_front for FIFO or explicit end operations for a deque while respecting possible wrapped storage.

records.title: Rust window indexing and borrowing
records.summary: Prefer shared slice windows or checked indices, validate zero-size semantics, and separate read-only views from mutation needs.

records.title: Contiguous sequence indexing
records.summary: Use integer offsets over a fixed logical element unit and account for shifts, copies, and boundary conditions.

records.title: Sort-versus-scan query trade-off
records.summary: Compare one-time ordering cost and mutation/allocation with query count, update rate, and per-query scan/search cost.

records.title: Sort stability
records.summary: Equal-key elements retain their relative input order only when the selected sorting contract guarantees stability.

records.title: Sorted permutation
records.summary: The output contains exactly the input elements and adjacent keys are nondecreasing under the chosen order.

records.title: Stays-ahead prefix proof
records.summary: Compare aligned greedy and optimal prefixes and prove the greedy partial state is never worse under a measure that yields final optimality.

records.title: Subtree induction and fold
records.summary: Prove the base empty/leaf case and combine correct child results to establish the parent result.

records.title: DAG topological-order contract
records.summary: Every directed edge u→v places u before v; a valid API rejects cyclic input rather than returning a partial/invalid order silently.

records.title: Maintained balance guarantee
records.summary: A separate structural invariant bounds height after updates; rotations/implementations are deferred.

records.title: Height-dependent tree cost
records.summary: Navigation/search follows at most one root-to-leaf path in O(h), where h may be linear without balance.

records.title: Traversal processing order
records.summary: Choose whether a node is processed before, between, after its children, or by level from the result semantics.

records.title: Trie key-unit and child-layout cost
records.summary: Choose bytes or scalar values and dense/sparse children from the workload; count nodes, edges, terminal data, and allocation overhead.

records.title: Trie prefix and terminal identity
records.summary: Edges encode key units and a terminal marker distinguishes an exact stored key from a merely traversable prefix.

records.title: Weighted shortest-path contract
records.summary: Declare direction, source, weight domain/sign, unreachable/overflow/negative-cycle states, path ties, and whether paths or distances are returned.

records.title: Window feasibility monotonicity
records.summary: Expanding or shrinking must change the constraint predictably enough to discard windows without revisiting endpoints.

records.title: Contiguous window state
records.summary: Represent exactly the elements in a half-open interval [left, right) and update aggregate state when either endpoint moves.

records.title: Build-script execution boundary
records.summary: Review pre-build executable code, its rerun inputs, native prerequisites, and generated OUT_DIR outputs.

records.title: Feature resolution
records.summary: Trace additive feature activation across workspace, target, normal, dev, and build dependency edges.

records.title: Manifest requirement and lock resolution
records.summary: Separate authored dependency ranges and package metadata from Cargo's exact resolved dependency graph.

records.title: Versioned Cargo metadata automation
records.summary: Inspect workspace and resolution through cargo metadata JSON with an explicit format version.

records.title: Cargo build profiles
records.summary: Choose dev, test, release, or custom compiler settings from build purpose and measured operational needs.

records.title: Workspace ownership
records.summary: Centralize shared resolution, metadata, dependencies, lints, and profiles while keeping package boundaries explicit.

records.title: Arrow typed physical array
records.summary: An array has one data type, logical length, null count, type-specific buffers, and optional child arrays or dictionary.

records.title: Bounded Arrow batch execution
records.summary: Process repeated batches under explicit row/byte targets and account for variable-width and retained-buffer memory.

records.title: Checked Arrow typed access
records.summary: Resolve a field, verify its DataType, downcast the dynamic array safely, and propagate mismatch instead of panicking.

records.title: Arrow offset-based values
records.summary: UTF-8, binary, and list layouts locate each logical value through checked adjacent offsets into a data buffer or child array.

records.title: Arrow RecordBatch invariants
records.summary: All columns match the ordered schema and share one row count; zero-column/empty behavior is handled deliberately.

records.title: Arrow ordered schema contract
records.summary: Bind each ordered field name to its exact DataType, nullability, and metadata before constructing or consuming columns.

records.title: Arrow slice and retained-buffer cost
records.summary: A slice changes logical offset/length while sharing backing storage, so small views can retain much larger allocations.

records.title: Arrow validity and null semantics
records.summary: Validity bits, not masked value bytes, decide whether a slot is logically present; null storage may be unspecified.

records.title: Bounded admission and overload policy
records.summary: Cap concurrent/in-flight items and choose wait, reject, sample/drop, coalesce, or spill semantics before capacity is exhausted.

records.title: End-to-end backpressure propagation
records.summary: A slow sink eventually delays or limits upstream admission across every bounded queue/state/output boundary.

records.title: Byte versus UTF-8 text boundary
records.summary: Choose Vec<u8> or String from the format contract; text decode is fallible and line delimiters are bytes with declared semantics.

records.title: CAP behavior during network partition
records.summary: When a partition prevents required communication, document whether an operation refuses/times out to preserve atomic consistency or responds while risking a conflicting/stale history.

records.title: Arrival, service, capacity, and queue latency
records.summary: Measure item/byte arrival and service distributions, burst size, utilization, queue occupancy/age, and sustained deficit.

records.title: Graceful bounded-channel termination
records.summary: Stop admission, close senders, drain or explicitly discard under policy, flush/commit effects, and make receiver disconnection visible.

records.title: Consistent state and source-position checkpoint
records.summary: Durably publish one recovery point pairing replay positions with all operator/window/timer/dedupe state that reflects exactly those positions.

records.title: Client-observable consistency guarantee
records.summary: State guarantees as permitted histories—stale reads, read-your-writes, monotonic reads, causal visibility, or linearizability—under named timing and failure assumptions.

records.title: CSV byte or UTF-8 field representation
records.summary: Use StringRecord for valid UTF-8 text contracts and ByteRecord when arbitrary bytes are legitimate, without lossy conversion by default.

records.title: Explicit CSV dialect
records.summary: Fix header, delimiter, quote/escape, terminator, comment, trim, and width behavior as source metadata.

records.title: Header-to-schema mapping
records.summary: Validate normalized names for duplicates, required/missing/unexpected fields and map columns deterministically independent of order when allowed.

records.title: Logical record versus physical line
records.summary: Quoted fields may span physical lines; errors and replay identify the parser's logical record plus byte/line position.

records.title: Missing, empty, whitespace, and null semantics
records.summary: Define per-column whether absent, zero-length, whitespace-only, or sentinel text maps to error, None, default, or real string.

records.title: Bounded row quarantine policy
records.summary: Emit redacted source/record/field/class metadata and stop or continue under explicit maximum rejected count/rate and replay semantics.

records.title: CSV structural, typed, and domain validation
records.summary: Separate dialect/width/header, UTF-8/typed conversion, and semantic/cross-row domain rules with stable error classes.

records.title: Bounded RecordBatch stream consumption
records.summary: Pull and process output batches/partitions incrementally under memory, cancellation, limit, and error contracts.

records.title: EXPLAIN structure and analyzed metrics
records.summary: Use EXPLAIN for planned operators and EXPLAIN ANALYZE for executed operator metrics, normalizing version/config-dependent presentation.

records.title: DataFusion schema-aware logical plan DAG
records.summary: Represent relational operations and expressions independently of concrete files, partitions, and executable algorithms.

records.title: Semantics-preserving plan rewrite
records.summary: An optimizer may change operators/expressions only while preserving output schema, names, values, multiplicity, null behavior, and required order.

records.title: Partitions and exchange cost
records.summary: Parallel partitions run independently until repartition/coalesce/merge operators move or synchronize data; more partitions are not automatically faster.

records.title: DataFusion physical execution plan
records.summary: Select concrete scan, filter, aggregate, join, sort, repartition, and merge operators for the data and runtime configuration.

records.title: DataFusion query and output contract
records.summary: Fix input schemas, SQL/null semantics, output fields/order, cardinality expectations, error policy, and resource limits before tuning.

records.title: Projection and filter pushdown evidence
records.summary: Locate requested columns/predicates at the data-source boundary and confirm reduced selected work rather than inferring from SQL text.

records.title: Event time versus processing time
records.summary: Event time is declared by the event; processing time is local execution time and cannot substitute without changing semantics.

records.title: Record framing and EOF contract
records.summary: Define how a record ends, whether a final unterminated/blank record exists, and how partial/error bytes affect record numbering and recovery.

records.title: Optimistic metadata commit and validation
records.summary: Build files/metadata from a base version, validate operation assumptions against the refreshed current table, then atomically swap the catalog pointer or retry/reject.

records.title: Field-ID and partition-spec evolution
records.summary: Track logical fields by ID and every file/manifest by spec ID so schema renames/reorders and old/new physical layouts remain correctly readable.

records.title: Measured data and metadata rewrite maintenance
records.summary: Compact small data files or regroup manifests only when observed planning/open/scan overhead justifies rewrite cost, then commit an equivalent table state.

records.title: Manifest tree and conservative pruning
records.summary: Snapshot manifest-list summaries and manifest file metrics prune impossible files, while residual row predicates preserve truth.

records.title: Snapshot retention and safe reachability deletion
records.summary: Expire only policy-eligible snapshots and delete a file only after complete reference/in-progress checks show no retained snapshot can reach it.

records.title: Catalog-selected snapshot truth
records.summary: One atomically selected table-metadata version names schemas/specs and a current snapshot; its manifest tree defines visible files.

records.title: Safe ingest error provenance
records.summary: Classify open/read/decode/parse/schema/domain/limit errors with source and record location while redacting untrusted sensitive payloads.

records.title: Ingestion resource envelope
records.summary: Set maximum total bytes, record bytes/count, nesting, and processing/rejection policy before allocating or waiting for EOF/delimiter.

records.title: Aggregatable latency distribution
records.summary: Preserve count/sum and suitable histogram buckets or equivalent distribution so threshold ratios and cross-instance quantiles have explicit error bounds.

records.title: Allowed lateness, too-late routing, and cleanup
records.summary: Retain window state through end+lateness, admit/update within that horizon, then clean state and route later events with provenance.

records.title: Lifecycle-aware provenance claim
records.summary: Record producer/time/event type and run/job/input/output facets as claims; deduplicate and order them, retain failures/partials, and grade confidence when evidence is missing or conflicting.

records.title: Dataset, job, run, and artifact version identity
records.summary: Use canonical namespace+name and stable run IDs, with version/snapshot/partition/schema/code facets sufficient to distinguish the exact entities used and generated.

records.title: LSM amplification and compaction debt
records.summary: Measure logical versus physical reads/writes/live space and slow input when pending flush/compaction exceeds bounded resources.

records.title: Flush installation and WAL retirement
records.summary: Write/verify a complete sorted run, install it in authoritative metadata, then retire only WAL coverage made redundant by installed state.

records.title: Mutable and immutable memtable lifecycle
records.summary: Apply WAL-backed writes to a bounded mutable sorted structure, seal it under pressure, and flush immutable state while a new table accepts writes.

records.title: Newest-visible read precedence
records.summary: Search newer memory/runs before older candidates or merge candidates by key/version, returning the newest visible value or tombstone.

records.title: LSM sequence and visibility order
records.summary: Order versions monotonically and select the newest version not newer than the read/snapshot horizon.

records.title: Immutable sorted run contract
records.summary: Persist key/version ordered entries plus verified metadata as an immutable file installed atomically into the read set.

records.title: LSM tombstone semantics
records.summary: Represent deletion as an ordered version that hides older values until it is safe to elide during compaction.

records.title: WAL-before-ack durability boundary
records.summary: Append a checksummed sequenced operation and satisfy the declared sync boundary before acknowledging it as recoverable.

records.title: Metric quantity, unit, temporality, and bounded dimensions
records.summary: Choose counter/gauge/histogram semantics, one base unit, reset/aggregation behavior, and a finite reviewed label set whose product fits the series budget.

records.title: Backfill coverage, reprocessing, and concurrency policy
records.summary: Enumerate target intervals, existing/running outcomes, code/input version intent, missing/failed/completed policy, dependency order, max active work, and reconciliation.

records.title: Acyclic task and data dependency contract
records.summary: Define tasks, required artifacts/data, success/skip/failure conditions, and acyclic execution edges separately from mere grouping or control-only order.

records.title: Retry-idempotent atomic artifact publication
records.summary: Read pinned interval inputs, write attempt-local output, validate it, then atomically publish one stable artifact/version key so retries cannot expose partial or duplicate results.

records.title: Versioned run and half-open data interval
records.summary: Identify workflow/job/task/run/attempt plus [start,end), code/config/input versions and separate logical coverage from trigger and wall-clock execution.

records.title: Arrow–Parquet schema compatibility
records.summary: Map Arrow fields to supported Parquet physical/logical types with explicit nullability and reject unsupported or semantically lossy conversion.

records.title: Bounded Parquet-to-Arrow reading
records.summary: Apply projection/selection before build and stream finite output RecordBatches under explicit batch/limit/error contracts.

records.title: Parquet file hierarchy and footer
records.summary: A finalized file maps row groups to per-column chunks/pages and ends with metadata offsets, metadata length, and trailing magic.

records.title: Parquet page encoding and compression
records.summary: Pages store levels and encoded values; page metadata declares encoding and optional compression for their column chunk.

records.title: Parquet column projection
records.summary: Select only required schema leaves before decoding and preserve deterministic output identity/order.

records.title: Parquet row-group boundary
records.summary: A row group is a horizontal record partition containing one column chunk per leaf column and a unit for statistics and skipping.

records.title: Conservative Parquet statistics pruning
records.summary: Use available trusted min/max/null and optional indexes only to eliminate regions that cannot match, then evaluate survivors.

records.title: Parquet writer finalization and publication
records.summary: Bound in-progress row-group memory, finish the footer, reopen/verify the artifact, and publish only the finalized output.

records.title: Partition key, locality, and skew contract
records.summary: Select a key from required query locality while bounding partition item/byte/rate growth and exposing hot-key or correlated skew.

records.title: Deterministic ownership and movement
records.summary: Map the full key/token space to one primary owner and an ordered replica set, with deterministic add/remove movement and no gaps or duplicate physical replicas.

records.title: Purpose-bound minimized data lifecycle
records.summary: For every data element/copy record subject/category, purpose, source, flows, stores, recipients, quality, access, retention, deletion/backup behavior, audit and owner; collect/keep only what is necessary.

records.title: Protocol deadline and cancellation state
records.summary: Apply connect/read/frame/write/response deadlines and specify whether cancellation leaves no progress, buffered input, partial output, or a connection that must close.

records.title: Versioned request/response envelope
records.summary: Validate version/type/request identity and define unknown-field/type and error-response behavior before dispatch.

records.title: Bounded application frame contract
records.summary: Define header/version/type/flags/request ID/length/body encoding, maximum sizes, and clean/truncated EOF behavior independently of reads.

records.title: Incremental bounded frame decoder
records.summary: Retain partial header/body bytes, emit zero or more complete frames, and preserve unused suffix bytes under a fixed buffer/connection limit.

records.title: Partial read/write progress
records.summary: Loop or maintain explicit offsets until required bytes are transferred, propagating errors and never duplicating a partially sent frame.

records.title: Transport semantics versus application messages
records.summary: TCP supplies ordered bytes without boundaries/liveness; UDP supplies bounded datagrams without delivery/order/retry guarantees required by many applications.

records.title: UDP loss, duplicate, size, and congestion discipline
records.summary: Bound datagrams/rates/retries, correlate responses, make repeated operations safe or detect duplicates, and tolerate loss/reorder without assuming the path.

records.title: Quorum overlap and response contract
records.summary: Relate N, R, W, available responders, acknowledged versions, read reconciliation, concurrency, and timeouts before naming an observed guarantee.

records.title: Client deduplication and majority liveness bound
records.summary: Use stable client/request sequence IDs and cached results across retry, while distinguishing unconditional non-Byzantine safety from progress requiring a reachable majority and eventual timing stability.

records.title: Raft commit and ordered apply rule
records.summary: Advance commit by majority counting only for current-term entries, indirectly commit their prefix, and apply committed entries once in increasing index order.

records.title: Raft log matching and suffix repair
records.summary: Accept AppendEntries only when the previous index/term matches, then delete a conflicting suffix and append leader entries so equal index/term implies an equal prefix.

records.title: Raft term, vote, and election safety
records.summary: Persist monotonically increasing term and one vote per term, reject stale authority, and grant votes only to candidates whose last log is at least as up-to-date.

records.title: Recovery point and catch-up capacity
records.summary: Bound checkpoint age/restore time/replay volume and provision enough post-restart service rate to catch up while new input continues.

records.title: Replay and processing-effect guarantees
records.summary: Define at-most/at-least/exactly-once managed-state effects and distinguish them from physical executions and external side effects.

records.title: Replication and failure-domain placement
records.summary: Define N distinct replicas across the intended host/rack/zone domains and state which correlated failures and responder counts remain tolerable.

records.title: Hints, anti-entropy, and repair debt
records.summary: Track divergent ranges/versions and retained hints, then perform measurable read/full/incremental repair before deletion/version retention makes recovery unsafe.

records.title: Versioned concurrency and conflict policy
records.summary: Distinguish causally ordered from concurrent versions and specify retain, reject, last-write-wins, or deterministic domain-merge behavior with its loss assumptions.

records.title: Missing and unknown field policy
records.summary: Version required/default/deprecated fields and deliberately reject, capture, or ignore unknown fields for the producer/consumer compatibility contract.

records.title: Deny-default per-request authorization
records.summary: Evaluate current subject, tenant/object, action, attributes and policy on every server-side path; grant only explicit least privilege and audit allow/deny without sensitive payloads.

records.title: Threat-scoped authenticated encryption and key lifecycle
records.summary: Minimize first, then use reviewed standard authenticated encryption/strong transport at the layer matching the threat; generate/store/separate/version/rotate/revoke/destroy keys under least privilege and recovery tests.

records.title: Authentication, session, and sensitive-action evidence
records.summary: Verify a claimed service-scoped identity through approved authenticators, protect/rotate/expire unpredictable session evidence over strong transport, and reauthenticate high-risk actions.

records.title: Untrusted-input to sensitive-sink boundary
records.summary: Canonicalize once, enforce server-side type/schema/length/range/allowlist and business semantics, and use structured parameterization or context-safe encoding at the sink.

records.title: Secret lifecycle and redacted security audit
records.summary: Give each secret owner/purpose/consumer/scope/version/expiry, provision with least privilege, rotate/revoke/test recovery, and audit use/denial/admin events while excluding secret and sensitive contents.

records.title: Asset, flow, trust-boundary, and threat contract
records.summary: Inventory actors/assets/data/stores/processes/flows/boundaries, enumerate abuse/failure cases, rank likelihood/impact, select prevent/detect/respond controls, and record residual risk plus review trigger.

records.title: Serde representation model
records.summary: Map Rust wire types to the format through explicit scalar/string/bytes/sequence/map/struct/enum semantics.

records.title: Stable idempotent or transactional sink effect
records.summary: Use deterministic effect IDs/upsert keys or coordinated commit so replay produces one logical external result.

records.title: User journey and good-event SLI contract
records.summary: Name the user-visible operation, service boundary, valid-event population, good criterion, exclusions, observation point, and data-completeness policy.

records.title: SLO window, error budget, and burn contract
records.summary: Set target and calendar/rolling window, compute allowed bad events/time, consumed/remaining budget and burn rate, and attach an explicit decision policy.

records.title: Deterministic event-time replay
records.summary: Given the same event multiset, timestamps, keys, watermark/idleness trace, and policy, produce the same ordered change log independent of wall clock.

records.title: Resource and execution-context correlation
records.summary: Propagate and validate resource, trace, span, request, and job/run identifiers so signals can be joined to the same operation without putting unique IDs in metric dimensions.

records.title: Sampled, redacted, retained telemetry evidence
records.summary: Collect only fields needed for stated diagnostic questions, redact/drop secrets and sensitive identifiers, define sampling bias/coverage, access and retention, and preserve missing/conflicting evidence.

records.title: Isolation anomaly taxonomy
records.summary: Distinguish dirty write/read, nonrepeatable read, phantom, lost update, read skew, write skew, and the broader absence of any equivalent serial order.

records.title: Transaction and external-effect boundary
records.summary: Bundle database reads/writes into one commit/rollback unit and keep nontransactional effects deferred, idempotently keyed, or explicitly compensated.

records.title: Transaction history and dependency graph
records.summary: Record each transaction's reads-from versions, predicate reads, writes, commit/abort, and real-time constraints, then compare dependencies with possible serial orders.

records.title: Whole-transaction retry and effect identity
records.summary: After serialization/deadlock abort, discard the aborted view and rerun all reads/decisions under a bounded policy while preserving stable external operation identity.

records.title: Monotonic event-time watermark
records.summary: Advance an explicit source progress estimate without regression; timestamps behind it are late by definition, not necessarily invalid.

records.title: Minimum active watermark and idleness
records.summary: Combine inputs by their minimum watermark and exclude a source only after an explicit idle rule, restoring it without watermark regression.

records.title: Keyed half-open window assignment
records.summary: Map each valid timestamp/key deterministically into explicit [start,end) tumbling/sliding/session windows using checked units/offsets.

records.title: Original practice: catalog probe
records.summary: Given a sorted unique identifier catalog, return either the matching record index or the position where a missing identifier belongs.

records.title: Original practice: closest ordered pair
records.summary: On sorted unique signed readings, return the index pair whose sum is closest to a target with lexicographic index tie-breaking.

records.title: Original practice: credit-adjusted paths
records.summary: Compute source distances with signed credits or return a reachable negative-cycle witness using bounded edge passes.

records.title: Original practice: dependency plan validator
records.summary: Return a stable valid build plan for all packages or a concrete directed cycle witness, including isolated packages.

records.title: Original practice: stable duplicate counts
records.summary: Return each alias occurring more than once with its total count, ordered by first occurrence.

records.title: Original practice: minimum-energy checkpoints
records.summary: Choose one- or two-step transitions through checkpoint costs, return minimum checked energy and a deterministic visited-index witness.

records.title: Original practice: checked expression-tree fold
records.summary: Evaluate a boxed integer expression tree postorder with checked arithmetic and return the first structural/arithmetic error by deterministic child order.

records.title: Original practice: fair bounded retry queue
records.summary: Process jobs FIFO; a first failure requeues once at the back, while success or second failure records a terminal result in processing order.

records.title: Original practice: first threshold breach
records.summary: In nondecreasing timestamped cumulative readings, return the first index whose value is at least a threshold, including no-breach and duplicate plateaus.

records.title: Original practice: fractional capacity allocation
records.summary: Allocate divisible supplies by exact value density under checked rational comparison, then exhibit why the same rule fails for indivisible supplies.

records.title: Original practice: maximum maintenance visits
records.summary: Select the largest number of compatible half-open maintenance visits and provide an exchange/stays-ahead proof plus counterexamples to two tempting rules.

records.title: Original practice: canonical maintenance windows
records.summary: Validate and coalesce half-open maintenance windows under an explicit merge-touching policy, preserving source-independent canonical order.

records.title: Original practice: earliest longest monotone run
records.summary: Given signed measurements, return the start and length of the earliest longest strictly increasing contiguous run and explain the scan invariant.

records.title: Original practice: nested metric total
records.summary: Fold an owned recursive category/value tree with checked arithmetic while reporting maximum depth and rejecting excessive depth.

records.title: Original practice: tagged nesting reducer
records.summary: Validate and reduce open/close records with typed tags, returning the first mismatch and maximum live depth.

records.title: Original practice: incremental network groups
records.summary: Process link additions and connectivity/component-count queries over stable node IDs using indexed union-find.

records.title: Original practice: minimal owned chain
records.summary: Implement a safe singly owned list with push_front, pop_front, and borrowed iteration, then compare its workload costs with Vec.

records.title: Original practice: peak fixed interval
records.summary: Return the earliest length-k interval with the largest checked total under explicit zero, oversized, empty, and overflow result contracts.

records.title: Original practice: prefix command router
records.summary: Store commands under an explicit scalar-value policy and answer exact membership plus lexicographically stable prefix suggestions.

records.title: Original practice: checked static range totals
records.summary: Build one prefix representation for signed readings and answer many validated half-open sum queries with explicit overflow errors.

records.title: Original practice: nonnegative route cost
records.summary: Return checked minimum cost and a deterministic parent route across a directed nonnegative network using lazy BinaryHeap entries.

records.title: Original practice: service dependency hops
records.summary: Return a minimum-hop service chain from a source to a target in a directed call graph with stable tie policy and unreachable handling.

records.title: Original practice: shortest nonnegative burst
records.summary: For nonnegative event costs and a positive target, return the earliest shortest contiguous interval whose total reaches the target.

records.title: Original practice: constrained slot assignment
records.summary: Enumerate deterministic worker-to-slot assignments under incompatibility and capacity rules, restoring path and used state exactly.

records.title: Original practice: stable alert ranking
records.summary: Order alerts by descending severity while preserving arrival order within equal severity and retaining every record.

records.title: Original practice: stable unique aliases
records.summary: Return the first occurrence of each exact UTF-8 alias in input order without counting later duplicates.

records.title: Original practice: token edit script
records.summary: Compute checked unit-cost edits between token sequences and return one deterministic valid edit script, including empty inputs.

records.title: Original practice: bounded alert shortlist
records.summary: Stream alerts and retain the best k by severity descending, timestamp ascending, then ID ascending without sorting the full input.

records.title: Original practice: null-aware projected-cost kernel
records.summary: Read schema-erased quantity and unit-cost columns safely, compute checked nullable projected cost, and return a row-aligned Arrow result over full and sliced batches.

records.title: Original practice: bounded metric RecordBatches
records.summary: Convert validated metric rows with nullable labels/values into an exact schema and repeated bounded batches with reconciled rows.

records.title: Original practice: build a fail-closed document gate
records.summary: Implement one pure reference-monitor function for a multi-tenant document read/update/delete request: validate/canonicalize/limit, establish session evidence, resolve object/tenant/action, deny-default authorize, require fresh proof for delete, call a fake parameterized sink, and emit redacted audit.

records.title: Original practice: bounded three-stage metric pipeline
records.summary: Build parse/aggregate/sink stages with item/byte/concurrency caps, propagated waiting, explicit overload/shutdown, and occupancy/age/service accounting under burst and slow-sink traces.

records.title: Original practice: checkpointed window replay model
records.summary: Checkpoint source position plus keyed window/dedupe state, crash at every publish/effect cut, replay to an idempotent keyed sink, and prove final equivalence/catch-up.

records.title: Original practice: bounded config snapshot
records.summary: Load a small JSON service config into a wire DTO, enforce strict unknowns/versioned defaults, validate domain invariants, and return redacted classified errors.

records.title: Original practice: bounded cost aggregation query
records.summary: Query nullable metric/cost batches by service and window, compute checked aggregates with exact order/schema, stream results, and compare to a Rust reference.

records.title: Original practice: projection and filter plan lab
records.summary: Compare controlled Parquet query variants, prove equal results, locate source projection/predicate and exchanges, and explain measured selected/decoded/operator work.

records.title: Original practice: out-of-order metric windows
records.summary: Aggregate keyed metric values into half-open event-time windows over two partition traces, using minimum active watermarks, bounded lateness, cleanup, and a batch oracle.

records.title: Original practice: expire and compact without data loss
records.summary: Given retained snapshots, a partial object inventory, in-flight attempts, file sizes and query costs, produce a safe deletion/rewrite plan and prove logical rows plus retained time travel are unchanged.

records.title: Original practice: plan a miniature evolving snapshot table
records.summary: Parse a small metadata graph, time-travel to a snapshot, plan files for predicates across two schemas/specs, preserve residuals, and explain two concurrent append/rewrite commit outcomes.

records.title: Original practice: rerun an interval artifact DAG
records.summary: Model extract→validate→aggregate for daily half-open intervals with pinned versions, bounded scheduling, crash-safe atomic artifacts, retries, and a missing/failed-only backfill; prove complete coverage with no duplicate logical outputs.

records.title: Original practice: strict inventory CSV
records.summary: Load a controlled UTF-8 inventory export under a declared header/dialect, validate typed/domain/cross-row uniqueness, and fail without partial output.

records.title: Original practice: classify and repair concurrent invariants
records.summary: Model account transfer and on-call constraints under read committed, snapshot, and serializable validation; emit complete histories, identify anomalies, retry full aborted attempts, and publish one stable keyed external effect only after commit.

records.title: Original practice: bounded JSON-lines ingest
records.summary: Decode independently limited newline-framed metric records, validate into domain events, preserve physical line numbers, and quarantine rejected records without logging payloads.

records.title: Original practice: late metric upsert log
records.summary: Emit stable key/window main and late result versions, apply them to a reference keyed sink, route too-late events, and prove final state/cleanup.

records.title: Original practice: reconstruct incomplete run lineage
records.summary: Normalize shuffled duplicate run/job/dataset events from two namespaces, retain a failed partial output and conflicting facet, build claim-backed version edges, and answer root-cause plus deletion-impact queries with confidence gaps.

records.title: Original practice: tombstone-safe run compaction
records.summary: Merge versioned sorted runs under a snapshot horizon, preserve read equivalence, install output before input deletion, and report amplification/pressure.

records.title: Original practice: crash-cut recoverable KV model
records.summary: Implement a minimal sequenced WAL plus bounded memtable/flush state machine and prove acknowledged key visibility at every modeled crash cut.

records.title: Original practice: thresholded metric CSV
records.summary: Ingest a partner export with explicit dialect and row quarantine, preserving logical positions, redacted errors, reconciliation, and an aborting reject-rate threshold.

records.title: Original practice: projected cost-range scan
records.summary: Read only needed cost/identity columns, conservatively prune row groups/pages, evaluate the exact range predicate, and report selected versus decoded work.

records.title: Original practice: finalized metric snapshot
records.summary: Write nullable metric RecordBatches to a temporary Parquet snapshot, bound writer memory, finish, reopen/verify schema and rows, then expose the artifact.

records.title: Original practice: minimize and delete a learning-data flow
records.summary: Model profile, attempts, compiler output, prompts, telemetry and exports across primary/cache/search/log/backup copies; remove unnecessary fields, set purpose/access/retention/deletion, choose residual encryption/key/secret controls, simulate expiry/deletion/rotation, and prove reachability plus forbidden-log fields.

records.title: Original practice: framed TCP command session
records.summary: Implement a small versioned request/response codec over a scripted/loopback TCP stream with bounded frames, exact correlation, arbitrary chunking, deadlines, and safe close behavior.

records.title: Original practice: correlated UDP probe
records.summary: Implement a bounded idempotent request/response probe with request IDs, malformed/unmatched filtering, deadline/retry/backoff/rate caps, and duplicate-safe server effects.

records.title: Original practice: drive a three-node Raft log
records.summary: Implement the bounded fixed-membership model for elections, append repair, commitment, apply, crash/restart, and request dedupe; enumerate schedules that preserve safety and schedules that lose progress without a majority.

records.title: Run a replicated register through partitions and repair
records.summary: Implement a logical-clock single-key register over three or five replicas with scheduled delay/loss/partition, configurable R/W, version evidence, concurrent writes, explicit conflict policy, bounded hints, and anti-entropy; emit client and replica histories before and after healing.

records.title: Place weighted tenants across failure domains
records.summary: Implement a deterministic small range/token planner for weighted tenant keys, RF placement across racks, and one add/remove-node transition; report coverage, load skew, query locality, replica distinctness, tolerated failures, and moved weight.

records.title: Original practice: calculate a rolling good-event SLO
records.summary: Evaluate availability and latency-threshold good events over overlapping windows with late/duplicate/missing telemetry, zero traffic and a release policy; emit exact numerator/denominator, allowed/used/remaining budget and burn evidence.

records.title: Original practice: investigate a slow data request
records.summary: Instrument a bounded synthetic request/pipeline with counters, aggregatable latency histograms, sampled exemplar, trace spans and redacted structured logs; diagnose one dependency failure amid a correlated noncause and report gaps.

records.title: Original practice: compute a transparent confidence ledger
records.summary: Join synthetic pre-feedback judgments to immediate and delayed scored outcomes, keep support/horizon separate, render raw band counts/accuracy/gaps and insufficient-data states, and prove the result cannot modify mastery.

records.title: Original practice: reduce an error catalog to fresh proof
records.summary: Build append-only entries from synthetic Rust/algorithm/data artifacts and evaluator evidence, review cause hypotheses, verify minimal corrections, author short future cues, and classify recurrence/resolution on fresh variants.

records.title: Original practice: author a faded ownership/data-flow lesson
records.summary: Create a small Rust ownership/data-flow worked example with goal, state trace and verification; turn it into dependency-ordered completion, fresh isomorphic, mixed selection and transfer items without leaking omitted decisions.

records.title: Original practice: route diagnostic evidence into a fading stage
records.summary: Implement a pure placement function over outcome/version/score/error/support evidence that selects example, completion, independent, mixed or transfer entry and reopens a precise earlier stage after later failure.

records.title: Original practice: implement an action-gated help reducer
records.summary: Reduce append-only attempt/help/action/bypass events into the next visible level and support classification, rejecting hidden reveals and clickthrough while keeping bypass reachable and level 7 explicitly assisted.

records.title: Original practice: build a compiler/docs independence packet
records.summary: From synthetic structured rustc/test evidence, record observation, hypothesis, focused official-doc query/source, one change and verification; declare supplied external help, then evaluate a fresh delayed no-help variant without inferring AI use.

records.title: Original practice: rebuild transparent mastery snapshots
records.summary: From synthetic append-only curriculum/event/artifact/observation streams, validate/deduplicate, derive all six states and evidence IDs, handle critical misconceptions/later failure/version supersession, delete projections, replay, and compare snapshot hashes and coverage distributions.

records.title: Original practice: build a confusable strategy mixed set
records.summary: Given original algorithm/data scenarios, define a reviewed three-strategy sibling set and contrast matrix, produce balanced unlabeled items, and score committed selection/rationale separately from execution.

records.title: Original practice: enforce retrieval before reveal
records.summary: Implement a pure attempt reducer that accepts one committed response before feedback, preserves support and item provenance, rejects post-reveal mutation, and emits practice versus independent evidence classifications.

records.title: Original practice: build an evidence-aware fixed review queue
records.summary: Project 1/3/7/21 due states from qualifying evidence and select fresh items with explicit retention/transfer/confirmation/remediation/project reasons, prioritizing later failure and critical misconceptions without changing mastery.

records.title: Original practice: rebuild a fixed spaced-review queue
records.summary: From append-only attempts/evidence, calculate transparent 1/3/7/21 due states and reasons while preserving early, late, missed, failed, reopened and policy-version cases.

records.title: Original practice: design and route a transfer ladder
records.summary: Transform one learned outcome into isomorphic, mixed near and changed-context far items; document every preserved/changed dimension and route ready versus blocked prerequisite histories through attempt, consolidation or direct teaching.

records.title: Separate confidence calibration ledger
records.summary: Join immutable pre-feedback confidence to comparable scored evidence, partition by target horizon/outcome/support, aggregate transparent bands with raw counts, and surface over/underconfidence only when evidence is sufficient.

records.title: Intentional confusable-sibling interleaving
records.summary: After initial acquisition, select a bounded reviewed sibling set, balance fresh items and transition pairs, require a pre-feedback choice/rationale, and update confusion evidence without randomizing unrelated topics.

records.title: Deterministic action-gated help ladder
records.summary: From an independent attempt, reveal the smallest next level, persist it, require an accepted new action before levels 2–6, allow bypass, and mark level 7 assisted with a fresh follow-up.

records.title: Diagnostic guidance placement and bypass
records.summary: Evaluate a fresh outcome-specific diagnostic, preserve errors/support/version, choose the least redundant fading stage, and reopen earlier guidance if later independent or transfer evidence fails.

records.title: Compiler/docs-first independence loop
records.summary: Observe the exact compiler/test failure, form a hypothesis, search official docs with a focused query, predict a change, edit once, rerun the relevant evaluator, explain the result, and declare any external/AI help before a fresh retry.

records.title: Evidence-linked error-to-fresh-proof loop
records.summary: Capture the error artifact and evaluator facts, propose/classify a cause, make the smallest correction, verify it, write one future cue/remediation link, then test a fresh delayed variant and update lifecycle/recurrence by appending events.

records.title: Deterministic evidence-to-mastery projection
records.summary: Validate/deduplicate ordered events, join artifacts and rubric-scoped observations, group qualifying evidence by outcome/model, apply transparent state rules and critical-misconception gates, attach evidence IDs, and rebuild byte-equivalent snapshots.

records.title: Fixed transparent spaced-review scheduler
records.summary: For each outcome, select the next 1/3/7/21-day interval from eligible evidence, preserve actual timing and reason, present a fresh cue, and reopen or advance review state from the result.

records.title: Retrieve-commit-feedback loop
records.summary: Present a fresh outcome-aligned cue, persist one immutable committed response, evaluate it, show focused corrective feedback, and schedule a later independent variant.

records.title: Evidence-aware fixed review recommendation
records.summary: From mastery/evidence/error/support and the versioned 1/3/7/21 policy, select a due fresh item and explain whether it targets retention, transfer, confirmation, misconception remediation or project prerequisite; record but do not auto-promote.

records.title: Evidence-defined attempt and transfer ladder
records.summary: From readiness-gated attempt and consolidation, progress through isomorphic, mixed near-transfer and changed-context far-transfer items, recording a transformation matrix, support and delayed independent performance.

records.title: Worked-example responsibility fade
records.summary: Author one reasoned example, omit consequential steps progressively, require fresh commitments and independent checks, then move through isomorphic, mixed, and transfer tasks while recording support/reveals.

records.title: Amortized means average input
records.summary: Confusing a deterministic operation-sequence guarantee with expectation over random inputs or choices.

records.title: Undo happens automatically
records.summary: Allowing shared mutable path/used state to leak across siblings or early returns.

records.title: BFS marks visited on dequeue
records.summary: Allowing converging predecessors to enqueue duplicate vertices and assign unstable parents.

records.title: Big-O is exact worst-case time
records.summary: Treating an upper-bound notation as an exact count and silently assuming a case and cost model.

records.title: Binary search works on unsorted input
records.summary: Applying interval elimination without an ordering or monotone-predicate precondition.

records.title: BST operations are always logarithmic
records.summary: Replacing height h with log n without a maintained balance invariant.

records.title: BST validity is only local child order
records.summary: Checking parent-child comparisons without propagating ancestor bounds to descendants.

records.title: Density greedy solves indivisible capacity
records.summary: Applying a fractional exchange to whole items that cannot be substituted proportionally.

records.title: DFS returns a shortest unweighted path
records.summary: Treating first depth-first discovery as minimum edge count.

records.title: Dijkstra tolerates negative edges
records.summary: Applying the settled-minimum proof when a later negative edge can reduce a finalized distance.

records.title: Caching any recursion makes it efficient DP
records.summary: Ignoring exponential/distinct state dimensions, cyclic dependencies, or expensive transition enumeration.

records.title: In-place DP update direction is arbitrary
records.summary: Overwriting a dependency before it is consumed or reusing a 0/1 item within the same iteration.

records.title: Item index alone captures capacity feasibility
records.summary: Merging partial histories with different remaining capacity into one subproblem.

records.title: Union-find returns graph paths
records.summary: Confusing equality of representatives with an ordered route or weighted distance.

records.title: Exact binary search returns the first duplicate
records.summary: Reading any matching index as a lower bound and losing duplicate-range semantics.

records.title: Hashing is ordered worst-case constant time
records.summary: Assuming stable iteration order and unconditional O(1) lookup without key/hash/collision/capacity assumptions.

records.title: BinaryHeap is a stable min-heap
records.summary: Forgetting max default and assuming equal-priority arrival order is guaranteed.

records.title: Heap iteration is sorted
records.summary: Treating a local parent-child invariant as a total order over backing storage.

records.title: Inorder traversal is sorted for every binary tree
records.summary: Confusing structural visit order with BST semantic key order.

records.title: Interval endpoints and touching are implicit
records.summary: Switching between closed/half-open and merge/no-merge adjacency without a domain contract.

records.title: Earliest finish maximizes interval weight
records.summary: Reusing the maximum-cardinality proof after intervals acquire unequal values.

records.title: Linked insertion is universally faster
records.summary: Counting only rewiring while omitting position traversal, allocation, indirection, and cache costs.

records.title: Every Rust list needs shared mutability
records.summary: Introducing Rc<RefCell<_>> before the topology requires aliases or multiple owners.

records.title: Local optimum implies global optimum
records.summary: Treating greedy choice as self-evident without exchange, dominance, or special structure.

records.title: Any graph negative cycle invalidates source paths
records.summary: Ignoring whether the negative cycle is reachable from the selected source and whether arithmetic starts from infinity.

records.title: Nested pointer loops are automatically quadratic
records.summary: Ignoring that each endpoint may advance only n times across the whole run.

records.title: Prefix indices mirror element indices
records.summary: Mixing inclusive and half-open definitions and subtracting the wrong two boundaries.

records.title: A base case guarantees termination
records.summary: Ignoring a recursive path that does not strictly approach the base case.

records.title: Set and frequency map are interchangeable
records.summary: Using membership-only state when counts are required or storing dummy counts when only presence matters.

records.title: Rust string offsets are character indices
records.summary: Treating byte length/offsets as Unicode scalar or grapheme positions.

records.title: Passing examples proves the invariant
records.summary: Replacing a general correctness argument with a finite set of observed cases.

records.title: Finish order topologically sorts cycles
records.summary: Reversing DFS finish times without rejecting an edge to an active vertex.

records.title: Every trie prefix is a key
records.summary: Confusing a traversable shared prefix with terminal membership and ignoring the chosen string unit.

records.title: Unstable sorting preserves equal-key order
records.summary: Depending on incidental tie order from an API that may reorder equal elements.

records.title: Vec front removal is constant-time queueing
records.summary: Transferring O(1) indexing to remove(0) while ignoring element shifts.

records.title: Sum windows remain monotone with negatives
records.summary: Shrinking or expanding based only on the current sum when signed contributions can reverse the expected effect.

records.title: Cargo features are exclusive modes
records.summary: Designing features as mutually exclusive switches despite additive activation and unification.

records.title: Lockfile guarantees bit reproduction
records.summary: Assuming exact dependency resolution also pins toolchain, platform, native libraries, environment, and final artifact bytes.

records.summary: Define behavior at the consumer boundary, implement it on valid local types, and call it through a correctly bounded API.

records.title: Implement a Rust vertical slice
records.summary: Take an unseen typed requirement through API/data-flow design, error behavior, tests, concurrency/resource bounds where relevant, and clean integration.

records.title: Ingest and validate typed data
records.summary: Configure a row format, decode typed records, enforce domain rules, and preserve actionable rejection provenance.

records.title: Isolate a deterministic failure
records.summary: Reproduce a failure with one command, control changing inputs, and reduce it without losing the causal mechanism.

records.title: Justify or reject an advanced mechanism
records.summary: Compare safe/native alternatives and approve the smallest advanced boundary only from a concrete constraint and evidence plan.

records.title: Model bounded domain data
records.summary: Choose primitive, tuple, struct, and enum representations that make valid states and operations explicit.

records.title: Operate a local production-shaped release
records.summary: Configure, start, health-check, observe, stop, restart, and diagnose a packaged service without hidden global state.

records.title: Propagate with useful context
records.summary: Use match/combinators/question-mark deliberately while preserving cause and adding operation-specific context once.

records.title: Prove cancellation and shutdown
records.summary: Test success, error, timeout, cancellation, and shutdown completion with controlled async time and observed task results.

records.title: Prove a clean Rust release
records.summary: Run locked quality gates and package verification from a clean environment with recorded inputs and results.

records.title: Query and verify Arrow results
records.summary: Execute a DataFusion query over fixture data and compare schema/rows/nulls/order assumptions with an independent oracle.

records.title: Repair a borrow conflict at its cause
records.summary: Explain overlapping uses and change ownership, borrow duration, or operation order while preserving behavior.

records.title: Select complementary advanced evidence
records.summary: Choose review, deterministic tests, Miri, fuzzing, or Loom from the failure class and state each tool's residual blind spots.

records.title: Select control flow from data shape
records.summary: Choose if, match, loop, while, or for from the data and termination contract and justify the choice.

records.title: Choose ownership or borrowing at a function boundary
records.summary: Select owned, shared-reference, mutable-reference, or returned ownership from the function's responsibility and caller needs.

records.title: Select the smallest valid Rust quality command
records.summary: Choose check, test, Clippy, or a combination from the evidence required rather than habit.

records.title: Ship an operable Rust artifact
records.summary: Produce a clean locked package and demonstrate configuration, version/provenance, health, bounded output, shutdown, restart, and limitations.

records.title: Structure an inspectable workspace
records.summary: Create minimal package boundaries and prove membership, dependencies, features, lints, and profiles through Cargo metadata and commands.

records.title: Test a concurrency invariant deterministically
records.summary: Construct a schedule-independent test that observes completion, shared-state invariants, disconnection, panic, or deadlock risk.

records.title: Trace expression values
records.summary: Predict the type and value produced by blocks, branches, function bodies, and statement boundaries before compilation.

records.title: Trace iteration ownership
records.summary: Predict Item values and post-loop availability for borrowed, mutable, and consuming collection traversal.

records.title: Trace a module path
records.summary: Draw the crate/module tree and determine whether a concrete absolute or relative path resolves.

records.title: Trace ownership and drop
records.summary: Mark owner, move/copy/clone operations, valid places, and cleanup for every relevant value in a small program.

records.title: Transfer Rust models into a flagship stage
records.summary: Apply ownership, error, testing, concurrency/async, data, and release models selectively in PULSE, QUAY, or TESSERA and justify omissions.

records.title: Verify the active Rust toolchain
records.summary: Explain the winning override and record exact rustc, Cargo, and component availability before debugging version behavior.

records.title: Rust Roguelike Tutorial — optional motivation branch

records.title: Learn Wgpu — active graphics elective
